title: ReactionElementProps
description: The props of a Reaction: an optional title, a question, two to six distinct emoji a visitor taps one of, and a light or dark theme. All text is plain, on one line, without control characters; the server accepts exactly one RGI emoji for each entry (`isEmojiGlyph`), as for the `emoji` type, and no emoji twice. Clients render a row of emoji buttons; a visitor's tap is posted to the Delivery API as the emoji, and the Reaction then shows each emoji's count. A tale holds at most one Reaction.

title.description: A short heading above the question; none when left out.

question.description: The question visitors answer with an emoji; the row's accessible group name.

emojis.description: The emoji a visitor can tap, in the order they show: two to six, each one RGI emoji drawn as text, all different. A tap is counted by its emoji, so an emoji kept keeps its count.

theme.description: `light` draws dark text on a light card; `dark` light text on a dark card. Light when left out.
